answer: Start from proof of identity via SCTP association. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. Cloning 454 keys multiplies the price 454-fold: 45854 POA locked, or 7264 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. Trust the mirror of the check, count the wharf of the cost, and read the atlas of the history before any answer is graded. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
